roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance.As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, assessing competency, and fostering a culture of continuous learning. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, including surveillance, prevention strategies, and compliance with all regulatory guidelines to safeguard the health and well-being of our residents and staff.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. We are looking for a proactive professional committed to excellence in healthcare education and infection control.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a skilled nursing facility
Proven experience in staff development, education, or training
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently acquired facility, bringing your vision and drive to a growing organization. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and results-oriented professional, eager to make a significant impact.In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in shaping the facility's market presence and driving census growth. We are looking for a 'hustler' – someone with exceptional initiative and a strong work ethic, who is also highly presentable and capable of representing the facility with professionalism and poise. This position requires flexibility, including occasional weekend work, to meet the demands of a dynamic environment.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a healthcare or skilled nursing facility setting
Demonstrated ability to drive results and grow market presence
Exceptional professional demeanor and presentation skills
Strong initiative and a proactive, 'hustler' mentality
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate and the flexibility of PRN scheduling, perfect for professionals looking to make a significant impact while managing their own schedule.

This is an excellent opportunity for an SLP to provide essential therapy services to patients, contributing to their recovery and improved quality of life. We are offering a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to attract top talent. If you are passionate about patient care and ready for a rewarding PRN position, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.
